faq.description: Answers to common questions about the supercharged 3.0 V6 petrol in the Land Rover Discovery 5. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a Velar or Range Rover V6 petrol fit my Discovery 5?
faqs.a: Not without careful checks. Range Rover V6 engines from other models can differ in output, ancillaries and calibration, so we compare your VIN and engine code with any replacement before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 306PS engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 5 V6 petrol engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 5 306PS engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any supercharger or cooling parts needed and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 306PS engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Land Rover V6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Discovery 5 306PS engine replacement take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 306PS?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 5 guide the decision. Coupling, water pump, thermostat and oil leak faults can usually be repaired individually. If timing chain failure or severe overheating has damaged the engine, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 5 306PS engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: A supercharged petrol V6 depends on effective cooling and clean oil. Where relevant, we inspect the water pump, radiator, thermostat housing, coolant pipes and supercharger drive, check the ignition system and gearbox, and renew the oil, filters and coolant.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 5 V6 Petrol Faults
engineProblems.description: The supercharged V6 usually gives early warning signs, so prompt checks can prevent a far bigger repair.

cards.title: Timing Guide and Tensioner Noise
cards.description: A rattle at start-up, uneven idle or camshaft timing fault codes may indicate worn timing chain guides, tensioners or stretched chains. We inspect the timing components and camshaft timing.

cards.title: Supercharger Drive Coupling Wear
cards.description: A rattle or knock at idle that softens as revs rise can point to wear in the supercharger drive coupling or isolator. We assess the supercharger drive and noise source.

cards.title: Coolant Loss and Pump Failure
cards.description: A falling coolant level, coolant traces at the front or rising temperature may indicate a failing water pump or weeping seal. We check pump condition and cooling performance.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Thermostat Housing and Pipe Leaks
cards.description: Damp patches, a sweet smell or warning lights can come from a cracked thermostat housing, ageing coolant pipes or perished hoses. We pressure-test the cooling system for leaks.

cards.title: Rough Idle from Carbon Deposits
cards.description: Uneven idle, hesitation or misfire codes on higher-mileage engines may be linked to carbon building up on the intake valves. We assess running quality and intake condition.

cards.title: Oil Seal and Gasket Leaks
cards.description: Oil on the undertray, burning smells or light smoke may come from hardened cam cover gaskets, front covers or ageing crankshaft seals. We trace the leak and inspect the seals.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 5 306PS Engine: The Complete Supercharged V6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 5 306PS engine is the 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol fitted to Si6 versions of the fifth-generation Discovery. Smooth and responsive, it can develop timing chain wear, supercharger coupling noise, cooling system leaks and carbon deposits, leading owners to seek repair or a replacement engine.

This 3.0 V6 Range Rover engine also appears in Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Velar and Jaguar models, with different outputs, ancillaries and calibration. We identify the correct Land Rover Discovery petrol engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 5 306PS engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
